# ExCom Monday Agenda — fill-in template

Reusable template based on the **11 May 2026** agenda format (sample attached in this repo at `docs/templates/excom-meeting-11-05-agenda-sample.pdf` if archived). Each Monday, copy this file, rename to `excom-meeting-<DD.MM>.md`, fill in the placeholders, and distribute.

Total time budget: **120 minutes** (~18 min buffer if all blocks land on time).

---

```
Καλησπέρα σε όλους,

Ευχαριστώ θερμά για τα status updates και τα νέα θέματα.
Ακολουθεί η ατζέντα της αυριανής συνάντησης.

Ώρα:     Δευτέρα <DD MONTH>, 13:00
Διάρκεια: 120 λεπτά
```

## Pre-reads

Διαβάστε πριν τη συνάντηση:

- **<Document name>** (<Owner>) — <"attached" / "διανεμημένο μέσω email">
- **<Document name>** (<Owner>) — <delivery method>

---

## A. Άνοιγμα · 10 λεπτά

Chair rotation status, Flash Report channel για ερωτήματα μέσα στην εβδομάδα.

### Status snapshot — on-track items

> Each ExCom member submits 2-5 bullets by **Sunday evening**. Chair compiles them here verbatim. NO discussion in the meeting — pure read-through, ~1 min per person.

- **<Member 1 name>**: <item> | <item> | <item>
- **<Member 2 name>**: <item> | <item>
- **<Member 3 name>**: <item> | <item> | <item>
- *(...continue for all ExCom members...)*

---

## B. Στρατηγικό πλαίσιο · <N> λεπτά

> Optional. Use when introducing a tool, framework, or shared mental model the team will need across multiple projects. Skip in weeks where no such item is queued.

### <Item title>

- **OWNER**: <Name>
- **TYPE**: Heads-up / Apply-It
- **TIME**: <N> λεπτά

<Brief description of what will be covered and any apply-it follow-up.>

---

## C. Carry-over αποφάσεις · 45 λεπτά

> Decisions deferred from previous weeks. Aim for 2-3 items at 15 min each.

### <N>. <Item title>

- **OWNER**: <Name(s)>
- **TYPE**: Απόφαση / Scoping / Input
- **TIME**: 15 λεπτά

**Context**: <1-3 sentences setting the situation, including any chair perspective.>

**Στη συνάντηση**: <What needs to be decided / scoped / input collected.>

### <N+1>. <Item title>

*(repeat pattern)*

---

## D. Νέα στρατηγικά θέματα · 20 λεπτά

> New items requiring decision direction OR introduction of an upcoming decision. ~2 items.

### <N>. <Item title>

- **OWNER**: <Name>
- **TYPE**: Απόφαση / Heads-up
- **TIME**: <N> λεπτά

<Description + what's decided in the room vs. deferred.>

---

## E. Heads-up batch · 12 λεπτά

> Information-only updates the team needs to know but don't require discussion. ~3-4 items at 2-5 min each.

### <N>. <Item title>

- **OWNER**: <Name>
- **TYPE**: Heads-up
- **TIME**: <N> λεπτά

<Brief update.>

---

## F. Κλείσιμο

### <Last>. AOB + παράδοση Chair για <next-Monday DD/MM>

- **OWNER**: <Current Chair>
- **TYPE**: Κλείσιμο

---

## Pre-meeting actions · πριν τη Δευτέρα

| # | Owner | Action |
|---|-------|--------|
| 1 | Όλοι | Διαβάστε <Pre-read 1> |
| 2 | Όλοι | Διαβάστε <Pre-read 2> |
| 3 | <Specific member> | <Specific prep task, if any> |

---

Ευχαριστώ. Θα τα πούμε <τη Δευτέρα / αύριο> στις 13:00.

<Chair name>
<Title>, Daios Cove

## English summary for non-Greek-fluent members (optional)

> Include when at least one ExCom member needs English. Mirror the structure but distill — short and punchy. Highlight items where that member is owner.

**Tomorrow's ExCo (<Day> <DD Month>, 13:00)** — Agenda fits in 120 min with buffer.

**Pre-reads**: <list>

**Agenda blocks**:
- **A. Open** — welcome, format reminder, status snapshot (no discussion).
- **B. Strategic framework** — <walkthrough item>, if applicable.
- **C. Carry-over decisions** —
  - <Item 1>: <one-line summary>
  - <Item 2>: <one-line summary>
  - <Item 3>: <one-line summary>
- **D. New strategic items** —
  - <Item 1>: <one-line summary>
  - <Item 2>: <one-line summary>
- **E. Heads-up batch** — <list with 3-5 words each>
- **F. Close** — AOB + chair handover for <next-Monday DD/MM>.

**Pre-meeting actions for <member>**:
- <Specific task 1>
- <Specific task 2>

Thanks,
<Chair name>
```
